Man fled Singapore on fishing boat to avoid jail, caught at Changi Airport more than 20 years later
clusters.summary: Despite being wanted by the authorities, Tan Khi Wie returned to Singapore several times using Indonesian passports under the false identity "Ken Srona".

clusters.headline: Africa: Africa's 2026 Sustainable Development Report Sets Priorities to Fast-Track Progress to 2030
clusters.summary: [African Development Bank (AfDB)] The 2026 Africa Sustainable Development Report (ASDR 2026) is setting the direction for accelerated action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the African Union's Agenda 2063, as countries and partners intensify efforts in the lead-up to 2030.

clusters.headline: 'We've had a lot of close calls': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
clusters.summary: More than 12,000 people have been forced to evacuate and some homes have been lost after a wildfire tore through Canada's picturesque Okanagan region.

clusters.headline: Decades of abuse revealed at Michigan art school. And, the Iran war's impact on midterms
clusters.summary: A new report has revealed decades of alleged abuse at an elite art school. NPR spoke with one of the victims. And, Iran is playing the long game with negotiations, which could impact midterms.

clusters.headline: Malawi: Bombshell Land Audit to Name Ministers, Judges and MPs Over Illegal Plot Grabs
clusters.summary: [Nyasa Times] Malawi's Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development is set to hold a highly anticipated press briefing this Wednesday to unveil the findings of a pilot land ownership audit conducted in Lilongwe - findings that are set to implicate some of the country's most powerful figures.

clusters.headline: Ethiopian death row inmates desperate to escape execution in Saudi Arabia call the BBC
clusters.summary: Dozens, many from Tigray, are awaiting execution - some called the BBC to tell their stories.

clusters.headline: A burial row over Zambia's late president has turned its election into a hot contest
clusters.summary: Hakainde Hichilema was a shoo-in for a second term but the controversy following Edgar Lungu's death has dented his chances.

clusters.headline: 'No safe options' for thousands sheltering in key Sudan city as RSF fighters advance
clusters.summary: International leaders have issued warnings the RSF may be preparing to attack the city, raising fears of further atrocities being committed.

clusters.headline: Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Nizhnekamsk kills 12, authorities say
clusters.summary: Ukraine has targeted Russian oil facilities with long-range drones almost daily in recent months. The barrage has caused fuel shortages in Russia and unsettled the Russian public.

clusters.headline: South Africa: Immigrant Traders See Their Livelihoods Destroyed By March and March
clusters.summary: [GroundUp] Traders with documents and permits chased away, leaving Bellville bus terminus market almost empty
